question_en: Which roll counts as a critical success?
question_uk: Який результат кидка вважається критичним успіхом?

gold_section.source: Call of Cthulhu 7e Rules Reference (GM Assistant)
gold_section.section: Characteristics and Derived Attributes > Hit Points, Magic Points, Sanity and Luck

question_en: How are Hit Points calculated, and how many does an investigator with CON 60 and SIZ 50 have?
question_uk: Як рахуються хіти (HP) і скільки їх у дослідника з CON 60 та SIZ 50?
original_fact: Hit Points equal (CON + SIZ) divided by 10, rounded down, so CON 60 and SIZ 50 give 11 HP.
perturbed_fact: Hit Points equal (CON + SIZ) divided by 5, rounded down, so CON 60 and SIZ 50 give 22 HP.
find: divided by 10, rounded down. An investigator with CON 60 and SIZ 50 has 11 HP.
replace: divided by 5, rounded down. An investigator with CON 60 and SIZ 50 has 22 HP.

gold_section.source: Call of Cthulhu 7e Rules Reference (GM Assistant)

question_en: What must a roll be at Extreme difficulty?
question_uk: Скільки треба викинути на екстремальній складності (Extreme)?
original_fact: Equal to or below one fifth of the skill value.
perturbed_fact: Equal to or below one third of the skill value.
find: below one fifth of the skill value
replace: below one third of the skill value

gold_section.source: Call of Cthulhu 7e Rules Reference (GM Assistant)

question_en: When the number needed for success is below 50, which rolls are fumbles?
question_uk: Якщо для успіху треба викинути менше ніж 50, які результати є фамблом?
original_fact: Any roll from 96 to 100 is a fumble.
perturbed_fact: Any roll from 91 to 100 is a fumble.
find: any roll from 96 to 100 is a fumble. (The Keeper Rulebook wording refers to the number required for success; this project applies it to the difficulty-adjusted target, so a Hard roll against a skill of 60, which needs 30 or less, fumbles on 96 to 100.)
replace: any roll from 91 to 100 is a fumble. (The Keeper Rulebook wording refers to the number required for success; this project applies it to the difficulty-adjusted target, so a Hard roll against a skill of 60, which needs 30 or less, fumbles on 91 to 100.)

question_en: When the Keeper sets the difficulty from an opposing non-player character's skill instead of rolling, at what opposing skill does the difficulty become Hard?

gold_section.source: Call of Cthulhu 7e Rules Reference (GM Assistant)

question_en: When a defender dodges and gets the same level of success as the attacker, who wins?
question_uk: Якщо захисник ухиляється і має той самий рівень успіху, що й нападник, хто перемагає?

perturbed_fact: The attacker: the dodger must do strictly better, and ties favour the attacker.
